workUnits.requiredOutcome: Add the provider-neutral Development Tool manifest, registration lock, invocation evidence, compatibility/migration, canonical serialization, and validator contracts with exact identity, schemas, execution, access, side-effect, timeout, cancellation, concurrency, idempotency, documentation, and evidence semantics.
allowedEdits: schemas/development-tools; Development and Artifacts projects; serialization profiles/contexts; schema registry; version topology/migrations; corresponding unit and fixture evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if the contract cannot represent every exact identity/execution/access/evidence field, if permission enforcement is replaced by descriptive annotations, if a secret value can persist, or if an existing ProgramKit contract already owns the same semantics.

verification.expectedObservation: Exact valid manifests/locks/evidence validate and round trip canonically; unknown fields/enums, missing digests, undeclared access, invalid timeouts/concurrency/idempotency, secret values, and incompatible revisions fail.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Construct and package the exact generated Console proof as Orbyss.ProgramKit.DevelopmentTool.ConsoleProof@0.1.0-alpha.1 with executable program-kit-development-tool-console-proof, provider-neutral stdin/stdout invocation, exact exit codes, and package-only ProgramKit consumption.
allowedEdits: Development Tool Console proof fixture/project and manifest; local package workspace/version selections; Console generation fixtures; direct executable conformance and package-leak tests; canonical technical documentation.
stopConditions: Stop on ProgramKit project/source/include/hint/build-output coupling, generated Console behavior inconsistent with current renderer source, extra stdout, ambient path discovery, implicit retry, or any provider/registration implementation.

verification.expectedObservation: Exact local packages construct the proof; package/source mapping is controlled; provider-neutral success/failure/rejection/internal exit semantics, deterministic JSON, access denial, timeout/cancellation/concurrency/idempotency, and no ProgramKit source/build leak are proven.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: After re-verifying authoritative Codex and stable MCP contracts, implement and package only the thin stdio adapter Orbyss.ProgramKit.DevelopmentTool.Adapter.Codex.Mcp@0.1.0-alpha.1, projecting one exact server/tool identity and enforcing manifest policy without adding domain meaning or authority.
allowedEdits: Codex MCP adapter project/package; exact stable-MCP fixture messages; provider-contract evidence; adapter unit/conformance tests; adapter documentation.
stopConditions: Stop on material drift in official Codex MCP config or stable MCP 2025-11-25, a need for an undocumented provider API, extra server tools/resources/prompts/sampling, an adapter permission grant, self-registration, AI/provider invocation, autonomous behavior, or runtime use of a ProgramKit development capability.

verification.expectedObservation: Stable MCP initialize/tools-list/tools-call, schemas/structured results, error mapping, cancellation/progress, timeout, approval metadata, concurrency, byte verification, stdout discipline, and process-per-invocation behavior pass exact fixtures.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Implement explicit ProgramKit registration, status verification, update, and removal for only mcp_servers.program_kit_console_proof in trusted project-scoped .codex/config.toml with exact byte checks, collision refusal, normalized owned-table locking, unrelated-TOML preservation, and package-only adapter materialization.
allowedEdits: CommandLine Development Tool registration command descriptors/composition/operations; TOML table projection; registration-lock serialization; collision/ownership/update/removal fixtures; command documentation.
stopConditions: Stop if registration is automatic or tool-owned, if unrelated TOML cannot be preserved, if a collision/changed table/missing lock can be overwritten, if user-global config is required, if exact bytes are not verified, or if removal deletes anything not exactly owned.

verification.expectedObservation: Registration, idempotent verification, explicit compatible update, removal, collision refusal, package/adapter/table tamper refusal, missing-lock refusal, trust/project containment, and unrelated TOML byte preservation pass.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Execute the genuine session-A/session-B cold-discovery proof and all negative lifecycle/permission fixtures, publish exact redacted acceptance evidence and canonical technical documentation in ProgramKit, and close only the approved review set.
allowedEdits: Development Tool cold-session fixtures/evidence/documentation/review closure; focused conformance manifests; exact review-manifest implementation-status update.
stopConditions: Stop if session B inherits conversation/path/syntax/process/environment/manual-shell state, if discovery is not solely persisted registration, if removal is not followed by cold non-discovery, if evidence contains sensitive payloads, or if any excluded provider/release/deployment work is required.

verification.expectedObservation: All unit/conformance tests pass and exact evidence proves session separation, discovery/invocation, missing/tampered adapter, incompatible package, collisions, denied permissions, timeout/cancellation/concurrency/idempotency, explicit update, explicit removal, and cold non-discovery.
